description: Declaration parity for scripts/check-declarations.mjs (added 2026-11-10). mismatches and unchecked are shrink-only debt: an unlisted mismatch or unchecked pair fails, and an entry that no longer matches fails until it is removed (node scripts/check-declarations.mjs --prune). Never add a mismatch; fix the declaration or the implementation instead. transformExports are permanent, not debt: names a native build transform adds to the bundled copy of the implementation only. Each name must still be declared-but-not-implemented and still be exported in the named transform source, or the check fails.
